book.author: Franz Kafka

week.title: The Last Night

opening_illustration.alt_text: Grete stands with her parents in the living room and tells them the family cannot continue this way. Gregor is in the foreground, separated from them and listening.

part_illustrations.alt_text: The angry lodgers point toward Gregor while Grete lowers her violin and the Samsa family reacts.
An exhausted Grete speaks seriously to her parents while Gregor listens in silence from the foreground.
Gregor slowly returns to his dark bedroom by himself while Grete stands beside the door.
Gregor lies completely still near the window as the dark night slowly becomes dawn.
Mr. Samsa firmly tells the three surprised lodgers to leave the apartment.
Mr. Samsa, Mrs. Samsa and Grete travel together on a bright tram and look toward the open landscape.

before_you_read: Can love change when life becomes difficult?
Can a person love someone and still want to leave them?
What does the word transformation mean to you now?
story: The three lodgers look at Gregor.
He says that he does not want to stay in the apartment.
Mr. Samsa tries to move them away.
But now she looks at her brother differently.
“We need to get rid of it.”
Grete does not call him Gregor.
“If this were Gregor, he would understand us.”
She believes her brother is gone.
She believes this creature cannot be Gregor anymore.
He goes back to his bedroom.
But nobody pushes him this time.
He knows their lives are difficult.
Slowly, his head falls toward the floor.
Early in the morning, the cleaning woman enters Gregor's room.
Mrs. Samsa and Grete are quiet.
The three lodgers come out of their room.
For the first time in a long time, the Samsa family decides not to work that day.
Mr. Samsa writes a message to his employer.
The three of them leave the apartment together.
They take a tram out of the city.
Their work is not perfect, but they have a future.
They talk about finding a smaller apartment.
A better place for the three of them.
Mr. and Mrs. Samsa look at Grete.
She is not the young girl from the beginning anymore.
She is becoming a young woman.
Her parents begin to think about her future.
Outside the tram, the world is open and bright.
At the beginning of the story, Gregor's body changes.
But that is not the only transformation.
But it does not belong only to Gregor.

visual_reflection.title: The Family Moves Forward
visual_reflection.alt_text: Mr. Samsa, Mrs. Samsa and Grete ride together on a tram on a bright day. The city and open landscape can be seen beyond them. Gregor is absent.
questions: How is this image different from the other illustrations?
Why can a bright image still feel sad?

reading_comprehension.question: Why are the lodgers angry?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: Because they see Gregor in the apartment.

reading_comprehension.question: What does Grete say the family must do?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: She says they cannot continue like this and must get rid of the creature.

reading_comprehension.question: Does Grete call the creature Gregor?
How does Gregor react to Grete's words?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: He does not attack or become angry. He returns quietly to his room.

reading_comprehension.question: Who finds Gregor in the morning?
What does Mr. Samsa do with the lodgers?
Where does the family go?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: They take a tram out of the city.

reading_comprehension.question: What do Mr. and Mrs. Samsa notice about Grete?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: They notice that she has grown and is becoming a young woman.

true_false.statement: Grete says the family cannot continue living like this.
Gregor returns to his room by himself.
The lodgers stay with the Samsa family.
The family goes to work normally the next morning.
The family begins thinking about a new future.

reflection.title: Final Reflection
reflection.prompt: Is the ending happy or sad? Why?

items: The apartment ______ quiet after Gregor returns to his room.
______ many changes in the Samsa family.
The family ______ continue living exactly as before.
Gregor ______ memories of his human life.
The lodgers want / wants to leave.
Mr. Samsa tell / tells them to go.
The family leaves the apartment together.
correct_order: The family leaves the apartment together.

speaking_mission.title: Who Changes the Most?
sentence_starters: I think ______ changes the most because...

writing_mission.title: What Does The Metamorphosis Mean?
writing_mission.instruction: Write about Gregor's transformation and how his family changes from the beginning to the end.

kafkas_final_question.prompt: Who really changes in The Metamorphosis?

questions: Are love and need the same thing?

human_or_not.prompt: When does Gregor stop being human? Or does he ever stop being human?

ending_reflection.prompt: Is the ending happy or sad? Why?

final_visual_question.prompt: Why does freedom appear only after Gregor is gone?

week.completion_message: You read a classic story in English. You learned new vocabulary. You practiced grammar. You talked about characters and emotions. But most importantly: you did not only learn English. You used English to think about literature.
